source.name: Berean Standard Bible
source.note: Headings only, for the 66 canonical books. None of the BSB's verse text is used here or shipped anywhere in the app.

deuterocanon.note: The BSB has no deuterocanon and no public-domain edition carries both those books and section headings, so these titles are written for this dataset. Anchors for the eleven books a Catholic edition divides follow those divisions, checked verse by verse against the ASV Byzantine Text; for 1ES, 2ES, 3MA, 4MA and PSS both the anchors and the titles are ours. English only: ASV BT is the one edition that carries these books and reads a heading set.

editions.note: An edition that divides its text differently from the KJV reads its own file. dra/cpdv/brenton/lxx2012 number the Psalms the Vulgate's or the Septuagint's way; luther1912/elb1905/ostervald cut chapters the Hebrew way in a few dozen places; asvbt moves the Romans doxology to 14:24. Every one of those anchors resolved against a verse that existed, so the validator reported 99.7% while headings sat over the wrong verse. Built by scripts/remap-headings.py where the edition is in English and the words can be aligned, and by scripts/reanchor-by-structure.py where it is not and only the verse counts can be trusted.
